results.title: Leo Lets It Rain
results.overview: Leo, a trans man with undiagnosed ADHD, is on his way to win back his ex-girlfriend when his plans are thwarted by a storm, forcing him to slow down and reevaluate.

results.title: Mercy Mercy Me
results.overview: In 1985, reformed outlaws Mercy and Khaos are pulled back into the life they left behind. They’re forced to take on a dangerous job that pits them against mob bosses, a crooked detective, and their own past sins.

results.title: The Best Pizza is in LA
results.original_title: The Best Pizza is in LA
results.overview: Filmmaker Pete Ferriero is on a journey to prove that the best pizza is not in New York, Chicago, or Italy, but actually in Los Angeles. Along with celebrity chefs and guests, Ferriero explores pizza joints in LA.

results.title: The Perfect
results.overview: High-achieving teenager Pärli feels like a mountain range: cold below the knees and hot in her hands. She compares parts of her body to different seasons and playfully envies a dancing grasshopper's movements. If not a ballerina, she imagines being a violinist or lion tamer. Aspiring Black Swan Maarja took up ballet at her parents' urging, though she preferred hip-hop. Ballet lecturer and horse rider Irina teaches students to appreciate the technically perfect ballet body, yet struggles to find joy and tends to censor everything, even as she resists strict control. All three strive for perfection in life and on the dance floor. Ballet offers escape into a magical world but demands patience. Dancers repeat exercises and rehearse for hours, seeking precision despite pain, fatigue or waning motivation. Each movement takes time to master, perhaps only to satisfy a mother's high expectations.

results.title: SOOBIN LIVE CONCERT MOVIE: ALL-ROUNDER
results.overview: Every dream deserves a stage. SOOBIN LIVE CONCERT MOVIE: ALL-ROUNDER is SOOBIN’s first concert film, offering a cinematic experience with 7.1 surround sound that captures the electrifying highlights of the "ALL-ROUNDER" concert series, featuring grand-scale performances and previously unseen behind-the-scenes footage. Released to coincide with SOOBIN’s birthday, the film marks a special milestone in his artistic journey. Beyond the stage lights lies a story of pursuing dreams through hard work, pushing boundaries, and setting new standards. With the message "THE ALL-ROUNDER IS ALL AROUND YOU," SOOBIN expresses his gratitude to the audience - especially his fandom, KINGDOM - for their constant companionship and motivation along the way. Anyone, anywhere, can be an "All-Rounder."

results.title: Wandering Trees
results.overview: Piero and his son Giuliano live alone, on the edge of town, in a farmhouse filled with injured animals they collect and care for. The Nonne, local notables, want to drive them out because they live like vagrants. During a snowfall, Piero disappears and the animals are killed. Giuliano has no choice but to search for his father.

results.title: Round 13
results.overview: Kamel, a former boxing champion, swapped fame for a peaceful life with his beloved wife, Samia, and their son, Sabri. But when a simple accident reveals Sabri has a bone tumour, their world is shaken. As their son bravely fights for his life, Kamel and Samia are pushed to their emotional limits. Sabri’s courage inspires, Samia’s hope endures, and Kamel, driven by love and pain, must face his deepest fears. After a painful separation, the family reunites for one final round: a fight not in the ring, but for love, strength, and survival.

results.title: Black Forest
results.overview: The film is based on real events. Standartenführer Fleischmann faces a crucial task. To solve it, he needs a poet who is on death row in a Berlin prison. As the film progresses, an unexpected connection between the "death house" in Berlin and post-war Nuremberg is revealed. For the first time, viewers are treated to a unique report from beneath the scaffold at Nuremberg. For the first time, the execution scene of major war criminals is recreated in cinema.

results.title: The Julia Set
results.overview: Julia, a gifted mathematician, navigates the cutthroat world of academia. Pascal, a teaching assistant, recruits her to join an exclusive training program for the prestigious and notoriously difficult Putnam mathematics competition.

results.title: Clean
results.overview: 'Clean' is inspired by a true story about an ambitious police officer torn between his sworn duty in the 'War on Drugs' and the desperate, personal battle to save his heroin-addicted brother. As he struggles to carry out orders, he faces gut-wrenching choices that pit his loyalty to the law against his love for family. 'Clean' is a quest to expose the pain, guilt, and hope within a man forced to choose between what is right and what is required.

results.title: Carmen
results.overview: An obsessed director, filming a modern adaptation of "Carmen," falls in love with the lead actress and gradually blurs the line between cinema and reality, turning the set into an arena of jealousy and self-destruction.

results.title: Romzsa Tódor
results.overview: Set against the backdrop of war, persecution, and political oppression in Transcarpathia, the film follows a steadfast devotion even in the face of grave danger. A timeless reminder of resilience, hope, and the triumph of spirit over fear.

results.title: TJPW club eX: Chapter Pause
results.overview: TJPW club eX: Chapter Pause was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW). It was held on February 15, 2026 at Shinagawa Prince Hotel Club eX in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: The Narrative
results.overview: As long as Kweku Adoboli is making millions for UBS in London, his future seems golden. But when the young trader takes responsibility for a $2.3 billion loss, the narrative shifts dramatically.
